description: The figure contains two stacked line plots illustrating a repeating sawtooth-shaped relationship between a vertical quantity and the horizontal variable \(m\), with a marked reference position \(m_0\) and several horizontal dashed reference levels. In both plots, the x-axis is labeled \(m\) with a right-pointing arrow, uses a linear scale, starts at 0 at the origin, and extends to the right without numeric tick labels; a vertical dashed line marks \(m_0\) on the right half of the axis. In the top plot, the y-axis is labeled \(n\) with an upward arrow, uses a linear scale, and shows labeled reference levels at 0, \(w\), \(c-a-s\), and \(c-a\); two horizontal dashed lines are drawn at \(c-a-s\) and \(c-a\). The plotted line is black, solid, and unmarked, forming repeated ramps that rise linearly from near 0 up to approximately the \(c-a\) dashed level, followed by abrupt vertical drops back down near the \(w\) level, repeating multiple times; to the right of \(m_0\), the same sawtooth pattern continues with visibly smaller ramp heights, with peaks staying below the earlier \(c-a\) level and oscillating around the \(c-a-s\) dashed level. In the bottom plot, the y-axis is labeled \(\mathrm{Size}_{\mathrm{rem}}^{a}\), uses a linear scale, and shows labeled reference levels at 0, \(c\), and \(w+a+s\); two horizontal dashed lines are drawn at \(c\) and \(w+a+s\). The black solid line again forms a repeating sawtooth: it rises linearly from 0 up to about the \(c\) dashed level, then drops vertically to a lower value and repeats; after the vertical dashed line at \(m_0\), the sawtooth continues with peaks clustered between the \(c\) and \(w+a+s\) dashed levels and repeated vertical drops to values below \(c\), maintaining the same ramp-and-drop shape across the remaining x-range.
